gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: One week of acting outgoing permanently increases all Extraversion facets.
gapQuestions.rationale: Short state/affect outcome does not demonstrate enduring multidimensional trait.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Digital coaching changes enduring conscientiousness.
gapQuestions.rationale: PEACH package/one-month-control, facet and observer limits; do not infer component effects.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: All personality traits are immutable because categorized stable.
gapQuestions.rationale: Longer intervention and follow-up evidence contradict absolute immutability.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: All Big Five facets change uniformly in coaching.
gapQuestions.rationale: Same-dataset reanalysis finds uneven facet/nuance changes and observer limits.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Repeated behavioral experiments independently reduce enduring IU.
gapQuestions.rationale: 12session course versuswaitlist, component and active-control/measurement alignment remain.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: IU treatment changes IU which transmits anxiety reduction.
gapQuestions.rationale: Simultaneously improving secondary outcomes and growth models do not identify transmitted causal mediation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Personality-targeted prevention demonstrates reduced sensation-seeking trait.
gapQuestions.rationale: Risk-stratified coping course targets drinking/motives; baseline moderator not trait outcome.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Completing behavioral challenges causally changes trait because completion predicts growth.
gapQuestions.rationale: Self-selected completion/compliance not randomized; common-method/endogeneity persists.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Need for cognition relates to elaboration/learning.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing030 is primaryreviewed once; task performance and skill outcome need exact entity alignment.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Thinking curriculum works through increased Need for Cognition.
gapQuestions.rationale: CRT increase not NFC-mediated mechanism; tested mediation not supported, and identification not guaranteed.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Plant-closure displacement changes openness.
gapQuestions.rationale: Quasi-experiment stronger than raw correlation but higheducation/job-to-job subgroup and exact upstream construct unavailable; EmploymentProtection is not plantclosure.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Employment protection strength causes openness because plant closures did.
gapQuestions.rationale: Institutional protection rule differs from realized displacement event.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Work/relationship events precede personality change.
gapQuestions.rationale: Longitudinal event associations with comparison/no-comparison designs; confounding/reverse selection and common panel overlap.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Marriage/retirement inevitably transform every trait.
gapQuestions.rationale: Specific small/heterogeneous or no reliable event-domain findings; no general causal law.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Psychedelic intervention changes enduring openness.
gapQuestions.rationale: Subgroup, support setting, drug and instrument variation; no class pooling or isolated mechanism, no treatment recommendation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Acute dopamine task sensitivity proves permanent Sensation Seeking change.
gapQuestions.rationale: Taskvaluation/approach versus enduring questionnaire trait and temporal scope.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reward/punishment sensitivity relates reciprocally to later externalizing.
gapQuestions.rationale: Partial within-person observational replication; exact endpoint and independent mechanism missing.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Bidirectional latent panel paths prove reciprocal causes.
gapQuestions.rationale: Model residual/time ordering not no-unmeasured-confounder identification.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: BAS equals Approach Motivation or BIS equals Anxiety.
gapQuestions.rationale: Trait sensitivity/state, shared item content and theoretical revisions not equality.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Trait Impulsivity equals Present Bias or inhibition task performance.
gapQuestions.rationale: Facet/self-report/task low convergence; beta immediatepremium not genericdiscount.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Noise/time pressure changes Need for Closure.
gapQuestions.rationale: Theory covers situational need; canonical time-scale conflict unresolved, not permission to edit.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: How should PSY130 enduring/situational definition align with Months–Years metadata?
gapQuestions.rationale: No new state Driver, split or metadata repair authorized.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cultural trait mean differences prove different latent personality.
gapQuestions.rationale: Specific Mini-Marker metric/scalar noninvariance; need instrument/group-specific evidence, not all-culture failure.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Stable traits affect affective susceptibility in specified inductions.
gapQuestions.rationale: Traitprediction plus experimentalemotion is not manipulatedtrait; exact031/041/042 causal-edge moderation not identified.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Extraversion modifies action→wellbeing under outgoing instructions.
gapQuestions.rationale: Evidence reports trait-dependent costs but no exact governed causal edge matching action and specific outcome; no moderator-to-outcome shortcut.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: An identity cue or values-writing session changes enduring temperament.
gapQuestions.rationale: PriorF11 identities target separate momentary self states, not F14 trait.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Storm/illness/displacement may alter enduring traits.
gapQuestions.rationale: Event occurrence and postevent distress not trait change; pre-event measurement/attrition/exposure alignment absent in bounded screen.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A network delta or altered contact opportunities directly edits Extraversion.
gapQuestions.rationale: Scenario operation not scientific consequence, no real-person ingestion or AE target expansion.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Personality inventory item scores are constituent causal Drivers of a trait.
gapQuestions.rationale: Psychometric indicators not ontology components or independent causal contributors.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Biological predispositions, repeated reinforcement and socialization explain trait change.
gapQuestions.rationale: General mechanism prompts, not exact causal segments; long-term designs/trait measurement required.
